# Guidera

> Guidera is an iPhone AI tour guide that tells source-checked stories about any place on the map, in 9 languages.

Guidera is made by Mehmet Selim Çetin, a solo developer in Munich. Facts on this site are kept accurate; if anything here conflicts with a page, the page is the source.

## Key facts
- Before narrating, Guidera researches the place from Wikipedia, Wikidata, Wikivoyage, OpenStreetMap and official city websites. A verifier removes anything the sources don't support. For little-known places the guide says less rather than making things up.
- Works on any place Apple Maps knows, worldwide, not just famous landmarks.
- 3 guides (Arthur the Historian, Max the Local Insider, Luna the Artist), 4 tones (Informative, Playful, Dark Humor, Calm), 3 lengths (Short, Medium, Long).
- 9 languages for app and stories: English, German, Spanish, French, Italian, Japanese, Portuguese (Brazil), Turkish, Simplified Chinese.
- 39 curated walking tours in 35 cities, plus AI-planned custom tours built only from real places (Premium). Walkman mode narrates tour stops as you walk (Premium). Tours can be resumed.
- Apple Watch companion; Lock Screen and Dynamic Island Live Activity (Premium). Follow-up questions (Premium).
- Pricing: free to download. Free tier: 5 AI stories per day (up to 20 with short ads), text stories, Arthur, Informative and Playful tones, banner ads. Premium passes (not a subscription): €1 for 3 days, €3 for a week, €7 for a month. Passes stack.
- Not available offline: new stories need a connection.
- Privacy: only the tapped place's coordinates are sent, never the user's location. No user accounts.
- Platform: iPhone, iOS 18.5 or later, plus Apple Watch. No Android.
- App Store: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/guidera-ai-city-guide/id6762008171
